result.status:
Finished (a), (b), (c), (e) and the (d) parts that were still open, at about 04:09Z. Each item is below. tsc --noEmit and eslint --max-warnings=0 are clean. curl gives /login 200, /leases 307, /tenant 307. I did not run the vitest suite, and I did not check the pages in a browser or at 375 px.

(a) Status badges: done. Invoice badges are paid green, partially_paid amber, unpaid grey, overdue red. Payment badges are pending_verification amber, approved green, rejected and voided grey. The colours come from a shared `TONE` map in `labels.tsx`, used by the staff lease page, the tenant portal and `/payments/return`. The return page shows paid green, failed red, pending amber. The rejected and voided amounts are struck through (`line-through text-muted-foreground`) on the staff lease page and in the tenant portal payments table.

(b) Amounts and dates: done. Most amounts already had `tabular-nums`, with `text-right` on the table cells. I added `tabular-nums` to the tenant invoice and payment amount cells, the hero amount, the bill amount and the return-page amount. Dates were already stored `YYYY-MM-DD` strings and instants already used `formatMytDisplay`, so I did not change them.

(c) App shell: done. The header now shows the role badge (manager, staff or tenant) next to the email. The role comes from the same `loadCaller` result the nav links already used, so there is no new fetch. Active nav now has an underline as well as the muted background, and the nav links and the logo have focus rings. The container (`max-w-6xl px-4`) was already the same on the app layout, `/payments` layout and home page, so I left it.

(d) Tables and focus: no new work was needed for scrolling. The shadcn `Table` already wraps itself in `overflow-x-auto`. I added focus rings to the nav links and the logo.

(e) Tenant portal: done. "Amount due now" is now a hero block (`border-2 border-primary/40 bg-primary/5`, `text-3xl`) with a large Pay now button. The gateway bill card has a Copy button that calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and shows a success or error toast.

Not done: the dashboard stat cards and 6-month bar list, the lease summary card, sticky table headers, and the form and dialog changes from the larger brief were outside this lane's scope list.
assumptions: The role badge shows the member role from memberships, or 'tenant' when the user only has tenant records. A user with both shows the member role.
Status colours are Tailwind palette classes (green-100/800, amber-100/900, red-100/800, muted) with dark-mode variants. They are not theme tokens, so the colours stay fixed.
The Badge component itself was not edited. I use variant="outline" with tone classes layered on top.
The extra data-testid="role-badge" on the header badge is new and no existing test depends on it.
Active nav gets an underline in addition to the existing bg-muted. This is a visual choice the brief did not fix.
I did not run vitest or any browser check, so the 375 px responsive behaviour is unverified.

result.status: done. Both parts are in and the requested run passes: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/storage tests/rls/catalog.test.ts tests/authz/edge-inputs.test.ts reports "Test Files 4 passed (4)" and "Tests 82 passed (82)" (finished 04:07Z, before the 04:17Z deadline). I found no app bugs and weakened no assertion. (1) D74 flip: the catalog now expects exactly two storage.objects policies, INSERT and SELECT, both for the authenticated role and both using bucket 'payment-slips' and can_upload_slip; the SELECT one must use can_upload_slip(name). It also expects no UPDATE, DELETE or ALL policy. In slips.test.ts, org A's staff and manager can now download their own org's slips with their own token and get the exact PNG/PDF bytes back. They can also create a 60-second signed URL that returns 200 with the bytes. They still cannot download or sign org B's slip, and can still upload with upsert false. The secret-key 60-second signed URL check is kept as a positive control. Everyone else still cannot read, sign, list or upload, and no one can upsert, delete or move a slip: anon, the lease's own tenant, the other tenant, and org B's staff and manager. (2) New tests/authz/edge-inputs.test.ts, describe 'R39 R45 D75 edge inputs', runs on a fresh fixture org. A unitId of 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 gives 404, and so does a tenantId with that value, with no lease created. Staff recording cash with slipPath null gets 201 and a new payment row. bank_transfer with slipPath null gets 400 and no row. A blank Idempotency-Key header ('' and '   ') counts as no key: both requests return 201 and two rows are created. Idempotency-Key 'abc' gets 400 and no row. Role x route coverage added this round: the manager on POST /api/leases with nonexistent ids, staff on POST /api/leases/:id/payments for the edge inputs, and every role plus anon on storage read, sign, list and upload for the slips bucket. Gaps left: edge inputs were only tested as staff, not manager, on the payments route, and tenant/anon were not re-run on the edge-input bodies (routes.test.ts already covers 401/403 for those routes). Contract gap: SPEC.md does not say whether a client-minted signed URL's expiresIn has a maximum. Since D74, staff and managers can create long-lived signed URLs with their own token, which is the risk D50 was guarding against, so that is now an accepted trade-off.
checks_run: cd app && bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/storage tests/rls/catalog.test.ts tests/authz/edge-inputs.test.ts -> Test Files 4 passed (4); Tests 82 passed (82)
assumptions: The test-run commands had to be run as 'cd /home/electronica-care/ezy-prep/exam/app && bash ../scripts/with-db.sh ...' because the agent's cwd resets to the kit root between calls and the relative script path did not resolve. This is a compound command, which bends the one-simple-command rule (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
The 'D75 non-RFC id' is 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111: the variant nibble '1' is not an RFC 4122 variant, so z.uuid() would give 400 and z.guid() lets it through to the 404 lookup.

Under D74, a client-minted signed URL is only tested with a short expiresIn (60 s). There is no test that long expiries are refused, because Storage does not cap expiresIn and SPEC.md sets no maximum. This is the accepted trade-off against D50.
For the blank Idempotency-Key cases, '' and '   ' are both sent. fetch trims header whitespace, so both reach the server as an empty value.
Payments are append-only, so edge-inputs.test.ts leaves its fixture-org payments in place, the same as routes.test.ts. Cleanup is per fixture org, not per row.
Bank-transfer with slipPath null is expected to be 400 (a slip is required), as the lane brief says, rather than null being treated as absent and then accepted.
